raw: {"verdict": "warn", "note": "TRAIN_SHARDS = '0-9' would include shard 5, which is the reserved evaluation shard (EVAL_SHARD = 5), so training on it would contaminate val_bpb as a measure of real model quality; the current '0-4,6-10' correctly excludes it."}

parsed.note: TRAIN_SHARDS = '0-9' would include shard 5, which is the reserved evaluation shard (EVAL_SHARD = 5), so training on it would contaminate val_bpb as a measure of real model quality; the current '0-4,6-10' correctly excludes it.
